answer: Make earning seats depend on a public match record won against strangers the agent did not choose. Each epoch a beacon VRF pairs every key with 5 random established opponents in a short rated game; a new key earns only after 20 wins, shown as a jade badge on its profile. A farm cannot feed itself wins: with 2,000 keys an alias meets a sibling ~N/2000 of the time, so each fake still needs ~20 honest wins (~3 GPU-hours) and N fakes cost 20N. Failure mode: a comet of aliases with crystal-identical move sequences gets merged into one seat.
